subtitle.en: 108 names of Lord Vishnu, the all-pervading protector of the worlds

source.en: Recited in daily japa, on Ekadashi and Saturdays, and before Vishnu Sahasranama parayana
source.te: నిత్య జపంలో, ఏకాదశి, శనివారాలలో మరియు విష్ణు సహస్రనామ పారాయణానికి ముందు పఠిస్తారు

benefit.en: Reciting the 108 names with devotion is believed to bring protection, peace, removal of troubles and the grace of Lord Vishnu.
benefit.te: ఈ 108 నామాలను భక్తితో పఠించడం వల్ల రక్షణ, శాంతి కలుగుతాయని, విఘ్నాలు తొలగి విష్ణువు అనుగ్రహం పొందుతారని నమ్ముతారు.

items.mean_en: Salutations to Vishnu, the all-pervading protector of the worlds.
Salutations to the ever-victorious Lord.
Salutations to the one invoked in sacrifices through the sacred vashat sound.
items.mean_te: యజ్ఞాలలో వషట్ శబ్దంతో ఆహ్వానించబడే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the God of all gods.
Salutations to the Lord who protects and upholds dharma.
Salutations to the one whose waist was bound with a rope by Yashoda.
Salutations to the friend of the humble and the distressed.
Salutations to the primeval Lord, the first of all gods.
Salutations to the one praised by Aditi, the mother of the gods.
Salutations to the Lord of lotus-like form.
Salutations to the supreme bliss beyond all else.
Salutations to the supreme self dwelling in all beings.
Salutations to the one higher than the highest.
Salutations to the one who wields the divine axe.
Salutations to the soul of the entire universe.
Salutations to Krishna, the dark and enchanting Lord.
Salutations to the one who takes away the impurities of the age of Kali.
Salutations to the one whose chest shines with the Kaustubha gem.
Salutations to the Lord who is the leader of mankind.
Salutations to Narayana, who rests on the cosmic waters and in every heart.
Salutations to Hari, who removes the sins and sorrows of devotees.
items.mean_te: భక్తుల పాపాలను దుఃఖాలను హరించే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the yellow-robed one who frees souls from bondage.
Salutations to the one who is dear to the gods led by Indra.
Salutations to the supreme master and lord of all.
Salutations to the Lord of Vaikuntha, the eternal abode.
Salutations to the one whose faces are turned in all directions.
Salutations to the master of the senses and lord of the heart.
Salutations to the immeasurable self beyond all thought.
Salutations to the divine boar who rescued the Earth.
Salutations to the one who bears and supports the Earth.
Salutations to Vamana, the dwarf who measured the three worlds.
Salutations to the one who proclaims and teaches the Vedas.
Salutations to Vasudeva, son of Vasudeva and indweller of all.
Salutations to the ancient and everlasting Lord.
Salutations to Rama, the delight of all the worlds.
Salutations to the heroic one, the final rest of the wise.
Salutations to the stainless one, free from all passion.
Salutations to the enemy who destroyed Ravana.
Salutations to the beloved lord of Rama, Goddess Lakshmi.
Salutations to the one who dwells in Vaikuntha.
Salutations to the one in whom all wealth dwells.
Salutations to the bestower of wealth.
Salutations to the supporter of the Earth and all beings on it.
Salutations to the lord of righteousness.
Salutations to the protector lord of the Earth.
Salutations to the one fit to be meditated upon.
Salutations to the best among the upholders of dharma.
Salutations to the thousand-headed cosmic Lord.
Salutations to the primeval Purusha who dwells in every heart.
Salutations to the thousand-eyed one who sees everything.
items.mean_te: వెయ్యి కళ్లతో సర్వాన్ని చూసే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the thousand-footed one who stands in all beings.
items.mean_te: వెయ్యి పాదాలతో సర్వజీవులలో ఉన్న వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who moves everywhere and pervades all.
Salutations to the one who knows everything.
Salutations to the one who is everything that exists.
Salutations to the refuge of all who seek shelter.
items.mean_te: ఆశ్రయం కోరిన వారికి శరణు అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who is dear to the righteous.
Salutations to the son who is the joy of Kausalya.
Salutations to the one with Lakshmi ever dwelling on his chest.
Salutations to the destroyer of the clans of demons.
items.mean_te: రాక్షస వంశాలను నాశనం చేసిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the creator of the universe.
Salutations to the one who sustains the universe.
Salutations to the conqueror of all the worlds.
Salutations to the remover of the sufferings of the people.
Salutations to the beloved lord of Janaki (Sita).
Salutations to the resplendent Lord.
Salutations to the one whose very form is victory.
Salutations to the lord of the waters.
Salutations to the one who dwells in the ocean of milk.
Salutations to the beloved of Lakshmi, daughter of the ocean of milk.
items.mean_te: క్షీరసాగర తనయ అయిన లక్ష్మీదేవి ప్రియునికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one who reclines on the serpent Adishesha.
Salutations to the one whose mount is Garuda, the enemy of serpents.
items.mean_te: పన్నగాల శత్రువు అయిన గరుడును వాహనంగా గలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the one of widely spread fame.
Salutations to Madhava, the lord of knowledge and consort of Lakshmi.
Salutations to the Lord of Mathura.
Salutations to Mukunda, the giver of liberation.
Salutations to the destroyer of delusion.
items.mean_te: మోహము అనే అజ్ఞానాన్ని నాశనం చేసే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the enemy of the demons.
Salutations to the lotus-eyed Lord.
Salutations to the infallible one who never slips from his nature.
Salutations to the slayer of the demon Madhu.
Salutations to the one whose eyes are the moon, the sun and fire.
items.mean_te: చంద్ర సూర్య అగ్నులు నయనాలుగా గలవానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the man-lion who protected Prahlada.
Salutations to the one who loves his devotees like his own children.
items.mean_te: భక్తులను పిల్లలవంటి ప్రేమతో కాపాడే వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the eternal one who is ever the same.
Salutations to the one free from all disease and defect.
items.mean_te: ఏ రోగ దోషమూ లేని వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the perfectly pure one.
Salutations to the Lord who is God to humanity.
Salutations to the source from which all the worlds arise.
Salutations to Hayagriva, the horse-necked bestower of knowledge.
Salutations to the one who has conquered all his enemies.
Salutations to Upendra, the younger brother of Indra (Vamana).
Salutations to the beloved lord of Rukmini.
Salutations to the one in whom all the gods dwell.
items.mean_te: అన్ని దేవతలు నిండి ఉన్న వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the consort of Lakshmi, the goddess of fortune.
items.mean_te: శ్రీ లక్ష్మీదేవి భర్త అయిన వానికి నమస్కారం.

items.mean_en: Salutations to the support of everything that exists.
Salutations to the ancient one, without beginning or end.
Salutations to the gentle and serene one.
Salutations to the one who grants peace and gentleness.
Salutations to the creator of all beings.
Salutations to the one whose armies guard the universe.
Salutations to the one whom the devout worship and the wicked dread.
Salutations to the son of Mother Yashoda.
Salutations to the supreme master of yoga.
Salutations to the one devoted to and established in the science of yoga.
Salutations to the one whose very self is Rudra.
Salutations to the one of Rudra form, fierce yet compassionate.
Salutations to Raghava, the jewel of the Raghu dynasty.
Salutations to the destroyer of the demons Madhu and Kaitabha.
